metas.name: Mean Girls
metas.description: A quintessential teen comedy that matches the sharp wit and social dynamics of Clueless and 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: Legally Blonde
metas.description: An uplifting, fashionable, and hilarious comedy about defying expectations that fans of Clueless will love.

metas.name: The Mummy
metas.description: A perfect blend of adventure, comedy, and fantasy that shares the high-energy fun of Jumanji and Dungeons & Dragons.

metas.name: Guardians of the Galaxy
metas.description: A high-octane space adventure with a sarcastic sense of humor similar to Thor: Ragnarok and Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle.

metas.name: Knives Out
metas.description: Since you enjoyed Wake Up Dead Man, this stylish and witty whodunit is the logical first step into the franchise.

metas.name: Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery
metas.description: Another colorful and hilarious mystery from Rian Johnson that matches your interest in modern, comedic detective stories.

metas.name: Kiss Kiss Bang Bang
metas.description: Directed by Shane Black, who also directed The Nice Guys, this film shares that same fast-talking, buddy-cop crime comedy energy.

metas.name: Bullet Train
metas.description: A stylish, high-action comedy featuring eccentric characters and dark humor, perfect for fans of Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: Easy A
metas.description: A clever and modern take on the high school comedy genre that resonates with the charm of 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: Palm Springs
metas.description: A fun and inventive rom-com with a sci-fi twist that matches your interest in comedy mixed with light fantasy elements.

metas.name: Stardust
metas.description: A whimsical and romantic fantasy adventure that echoes the magical charm of Practical Magic and Fantastic Beasts.

metas.name: The Princess Bride
metas.description: A timeless classic that combines romance, comedy, and fantasy adventure in a way that viewers of Practical Magic will appreciate.

metas.name: Kingsman: The Secret Service
metas.description: High-octane, stylish action with a strong sense of humor, ideal for fans who enjoyed the fun pace of Jumanji and Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: Free Guy
metas.description: Set inside a video game, this film offers the same fun, lighthearted adventure and visual spectacle as the Jumanji sequels.

metas.name: The Grand Budapest Hotel
metas.description: A quirky and visually stunning comedy-caper that aligns with the whimsical tone of Night Is Short, Walk On Girl.

metas.name: Hot Fuzz
metas.description: A brilliant action-comedy that subverts genre tropes, matching the sharp humor found in The Nice Guys.

metas.name: Game Night
metas.description: A high-stakes comedy with mystery elements that provides non-stop laughs similar to the Jumanji franchise.

metas.name: 21 Jump Street
metas.description: A hilarious and self-aware action-comedy that captures the fun and irreverent spirit of Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: The Lost City
metas.description: A lighthearted jungle adventure and romance that feels very much in the spirit of Jumanji and Dungeons & Dragons.

metas.name: Beetlejuice
metas.description: A fun, supernatural comedy that matches the quirky magical vibes of Practical Magic and D&D: Honor Among Thieves.

metas.name: Hocus Pocus
metas.description: A comfort-movie classic involving magic and comedy, perfect for fans of Practical Magic.

metas.name: Big Trouble in Little China
metas.description: An 80s cult classic that blends action, fantasy, and comedy in a chaotic, fun way that mirrors Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: Spy
metas.description: A high-energy action-comedy that is both a parody of spy films and a great example of the genre, offering many laughs.

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description: The ultimate feel-good movie; it's heartwarming, funny, and visually delightful, offering pure comfort.

metas.name: About Time
metas.description: A sweet romance with a light fantasy time-travel element that matches the romantic-magical tone of Practical Magic.

metas.name: The Heat
metas.description: A loud and funny buddy-cop movie that pairs well with the comedic dynamic seen in The Nice Guys.

metas.name: Deadpool
metas.description: An irreverent and high-action superhero film that matches the comedic energy and meta-humor of Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: Shaun of the Dead
metas.description: A 'rom-zom-com' that blends comedy and adventure perfectly, matching your taste for genre-bending fun.

metas.name: Shazam!
metas.description: A lighthearted and funny superhero origin story that captures the youthful sense of wonder found in Jumanji.

metas.name: Enola Holmes
metas.description: A fun, fast-paced mystery with a charming lead, ideal for fans of Knives Out and Dungeons & Dragons.

metas.name: Pitch Perfect
metas.description: An easy-to-watch, comedic, and musical film that provides the same lighthearted entertainment as Clueless.

metas.name: Booksmart
metas.description: A modern teen comedy with great chemistry between its leads, reminiscent of the energy in 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: Bring It On
metas.description: A classic early 2000s teen comedy that is light, energetic, and highly rewatchable like Clueless.

metas.name: Scott Pilgrim vs. the World
metas.description: A visually unique action-comedy that blends romance and fantasy in a way that matches your interest in stylized fun.

metas.name: The Mask
metas.description: Fans of Ace Ventura: Pet Detective will appreciate Jim Carrey's high-energy physical comedy and the film's whimsical fantasy elements.

metas.name: Galaxy Quest
metas.description: A hilarious sci-fi comedy that celebrates and parodies space adventures, fitting the fun tone of Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: Ocean's Eleven
metas.description: A cool, stylish, and funny heist movie that matches the slick dialogue and crime-comedy vibes of Get Shorty.

metas.name: Crazy Rich Asians
metas.description: A beautiful, funny, and uplifting romantic comedy that offers high-quality production and a feel-good story.

metas.name: The Birdcage
metas.description: A hilarious and heartwarming comedy with fantastic performances that provides top-tier comfort and laughs.

metas.name: Midnight in Paris
metas.description: A whimsical, light fantasy romance that deals with nostalgia in a way that matches the charm of Night Is Short, Walk On Girl.
